title: Geometry - Lesson 8 Practice: CPCTC and Theorem Problems
description: Practice using triangle congruence, CPCTC, and related triangle theorems to prove and solve corresponding-part problems.

questions.question: What does CPCTC stand for?
options: Congruent Parts Create Two Congruent triangles
Corresponding Parts of Congruent Triangles are Congruent
questions.explanation: CPCTC means Corresponding Parts of Congruent Triangles are Congruent.

questions.question: If triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF, which side corresponds to side AC?
questions.explanation: The order gives A matching D, B matching E, and C matching F, so AC corresponds to DF.

questions.question: Which reason can prove two right triangles congruent when their hypotenuses and one pair of legs are congruent?
questions.explanation: HL is the right-triangle congruence theorem using a congruent hypotenuse and one congruent leg.

questions.question: CPCTC should be used only after two triangles have been proven congruent.
questions.explanation: CPCTC depends on a previous triangle congruence statement.

questions.question: A triangle midline is parallel to the third side and equal in length to the third side.
questions.explanation: A midline is parallel to the third side, but it is half as long as the third side.

questions.question: If point P is on the perpendicular bisector of segment AB, then PA = ______.
questions.explanation: The Perpendicular Bisector Theorem says a point on the perpendicular bisector is equidistant from the endpoints.

questions.question: A midline of a triangle measures 13 cm. The parallel third side measures ______ cm.
questions.explanation: The third side is twice the midline, so 2 times 13 is 26.

questions.question: A proof shows triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. Explain how you can conclude angle B is congruent to angle E.
questions.correctAnswer: Since the triangles are congruent and B corresponds to E in the congruence statement, angle B is congruent to angle E by CPCTC.
questions.explanation: Once triangle congruence is established, corresponding angles may be concluded congruent by CPCTC.
